text.en: Pet owners emphasize the facility's thoughtful approach to introducing new or nervous dogs into group play. Reviews note that staff members handle sensitive puppies and high-energy dogs with equal skill, offering structured enrichment walks and social time. Dogs return home contented and thoroughly exercised after each session.

Reviewers warmly praise the Hillcrest team for their kind demeanor and genuine passion for animals. Clients highlight individual staff members such as Ashley, Jordan, and stylist Janetta, noting their patience with cautious pets. Pet parents appreciate that staff take time to reassure both animals and their owners during intake.

title.en: Regular updates and photo report cards

text.en: Clients consistently commend the digital communication provided during daycare and boarding reservations. Pet parents receive frequent photographs and detailed report cards detailing how their dogs spent their day. These regular messages provide significant reassurance to owners while working long hours or travelling away on holiday.

q.en: How does the resort introduce new dogs to group play?

a.en: New dogs complete a structured meet-and-greet trial where staff evaluate their temperament and gradually introduce them to compatible playgroups.

q.en: Do owners receive photos during daycare and boarding?

a.en: Yes, clients receive regular photo updates and digital report cards summarizing their dog's activities and social interactions throughout the day.

q.en: Are grooming and bath appointments available at Hillcrest?

a.en: Pet parents report using the facility for dog grooming and nail clipping, praising the stylists for patient handling of challenging pets.

q.en: What extra activities are offered during boarding stays?

a.en: Reviewers highlight optional enrichment walks and extended playtimes that keep active dogs engaged and mentally stimulated.
